reviews.title: Beware of This Company’s Subscription Practices. Feels Like a Scam.
reviews.text:
I strongly recommend staying away from this AI company. I discovered that I was being charged for a subscription I didn’t even realize I had signed up for. The lack of transparency around their billing practices is extremely concerning.

I submitted two refund requests through Apple, and both were denied. Now I’m having to contact the company directly just to try to get my money back.

In my experience, these subscription practices feel incredibly deceptive and predatory. Customers should not have to jump through hoops to recover money for services they didn’t knowingly intend to pay for.

My advice: Stay away, check your subscriptions carefully, and think twice before giving this company your payment information.

This entire experience has left me feeling scammed. I would give zero stars if I could.

reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.text:
I highly recommend avoiding this AI Maker app. It’s a complete waste of money. Even after paying for credits, you lose access to your unused credits once your subscription expires. Credits you’ve already paid for should remain yours to use, regardless of whether you cancel your subscription.

To make matters worse, the videos don’t even play the full songs as you would expect. Instead, you’re only getting a few seconds of audio, which is extremely misleading and disappointing.

Between losing paid credits and receiving incomplete videos, this app offers terrible value for the money. The subscription practices are frustrating, and the limitations are not worth the cost. Save your money and look elsewhere!

reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.text: Alright so I came here from an ad on tiktok. The ad made it seem like I could upload a full body photo and have that photo dance. Well I start the free trial, it gives you 1000 credits, normal I think for a free trial, I assume you get more after, but I don’t know because I have canceled it. Reason for cancel, I tried to upload a full body photo twice. It insists I provide it a face. I then try and give it a face photo. Apparently all faces aren’t created equal because it insists I provide it a face. I try with another face. Closer. It accepts this. Keeping in mind the ad shows a full body photo matching the dance move of a video. Well it says “30 minutes left”. Now this is the moment I scoff, because other apps take like 6 minutes tops. Well some seconds go by and it says there was a problem and they are giving me my credits back. I do get the credits back. So I try again. The second time same error, and this time when they say they are returning my credits, they don’t. Canceled the free trial. So I don’t even know if it actually DOES do what the ad shows but just from what I have seen I would bet money that it won’t.
